\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{آگے} (āge)}{آگے (āge)}]{\ur{آگے} (āge) — ahead, forward}

\label{lesson:UR-C246-age}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a garage, then the Urdu for everywhere.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{آگے}}
\textbf{\ur{آگے}} — \emph{āge} — \textquotedblleft{}ahead, forward\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{آگے}} (\emph{āge}) is a tadbhava, a word inherited from Sanskrit and reshaped by sound change. It comes from \emph{agra}, \textquotedblleft{}top, front\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 68). \emph{āge} continues the Sanskrit forms \emph{agre}, \emph{agreṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}in front\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{سرحد}}
\textbf{\ur{سرحد}} — \emph{sarhad} — \textquotedblleft{}a border\textquotedblright{}.
